summary: Phase 12 Technical Architecture & Implementation Plan: Next-Generation Universal PDF-to-Word & Financial Document Intelligence Engine. Incorporates confirmed user decisions (profile auto-detection with manual override, inline interactive Quality HUD with audit checklist, ambiguous character review indicators), specialized financial classifiers (India GST Rule 46, International VAT/Sales Tax, Banking/Ledgers, Commercial docs), numeric/identifier integrity preservation, 3 professional conversion modes, and comprehensive testing matrix across 25 fixtures while strictly maintaining the zero-server-upload privacy model and production freeze.
